prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create ONLY a supplemental idle animation atlas, preserving the approved character drawing/style.
Reference image 1 is the EXACT CURRENT CHARACTER IDENTITY and pixel art to preserve: Kim Yeonwoo, long straight black hair, small pink clip, impassive face, black wrap top with cobalt lapel and cuffs, pink inner sash, short black skirt with blue hem, bare knees, black lace-up boots, short slack steel chain in her lowered hand. Do not change face, hair, proportions, clothing, colors, rendering detail or outfit. The standing poses in its top-left two cells are the base.
Reference image 2 is OLD ANIMATION MOTION REFERENCE ONLY. Study the small changing foot spacing and shifting support leg in its first two rows. Do not copy its trousers or old costume. Recreate that restrained small side-step/foot-rock rhythm using the CURRENT design from image 1.
Output EXACTLY 8 complete full-body frames in a regular FOUR columns by TWO rows grid, transparent background, 1536x1024 landscape, equal cells, generous empty padding. Identical body scale, facing RIGHT three-quarter in every frame, soles share one ground line, torso centered at same anchor.
Motion: subtle alternating side steps in place, composed relaxed upper body. Frame1 neutral feet slightly apart. Frame2 weight settles onto rear/left leg, front/right boot heel lifts slightly and knee bends. Frame3 front/right boot steps slightly outward to the right (about one tenth of a boot width, NOT a walk stride), upper body drifts only a tiny amount toward it. Frame4 front/right boot plants and takes weight. Frame5 weight shifts toward front/right support leg, rear/left heel lifts slightly. Frame6 rear/left boot draws slightly inward under the hips. Frame7 rear/left boot returns outward to its original place and plants. Frame8 settles into frame1 ready to loop.
Feet and ankle/knee shapes MUST actually differ across frames; do not repeat one pose with different hair or translate the entire image. This is a very small sideways weight transfer, not walking forward, hopping, dancing, squatting, or bouncing. One foot always planted. Hair and dangling chain have minimal delayed sway. Arms stay down. Expression stays impassive. Keep the original tall detailed pixel art proportions, no chibi or smooth illustration, no blur or effect. Entire character and chain contained within every cell. Real transparent alpha background, no backdrop, shadows, text, numbers or grid.
